name: service-status
description: Tell coding agents when a failure is a third-party outage, not their bug.

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm fmt:check && pnpm validate:offline && pnpm test
scripts.eval:prepare: rm -rf evals/skills evals/hooks && cp -R plugins/service-status/skills evals/skills && cp -R plugins/service-status-hook/hooks evals/hooks
